bridge_add.title: Add Device Bridge
bridge_add.description:
Bridge an HA entity to a Loxone control. The integration auto-detects the mapping type.

For lights, add an RGB/Dimmer/Switch circuit to a Lighting Controller in Loxone Config first.

data_description.loxone_control: Pick a Loxone control or light circuit. Only controls with "Use in Visualization" enabled appear. Reload the integration to refresh the list.

persistent_disconnect.title: Cannot reach Loxone Miniserver
persistent_disconnect.description: Multiple reconnection attempts to **{host}** have failed. Check that the Miniserver is powered on, reachable on the network, and not in maintenance mode. The integration will keep retrying in the background.

meter_unit_mismatch.title: Meter unit mismatch: {name}
meter_unit_mismatch.description: The **{name}** meter is configured as type **{meter_type}** in Loxone Config, but its **{state_key}** format string resolved to device class **{detected_class}**. This may cause incorrect readings in the Energy dashboard. Check the format string in Loxone Config to ensure it matches the meter type.

reload.name: Pyloxone Reload
reload.description: Reloads the Loxone integration by reconnecting to the Miniserver and refreshing all entities. This is useful after making configuration changes in Loxone Config or when connection issues occur. All current entity states will be re\-synchronized from the Miniserver.
